$comment: Guardrails, evaluated on every action in BOTH discovery and replay. Discovery is not a trusted context: a model exploring a back-office app is exactly where an unbounded action does damage.

allowlist.$comment: routes/denyRoutes are matched against pathname + query string, so a query-string-routed action (?fn=delete, the norm for a legacy .asp app) can be denied too, not just a REST-style path segment.

risk.$comment: Default is safe; the first matching rule wins. Irreversible actions never run unattended, regardless of approval state. nameMatches patterns are always matched case-insensitively - do not write inline (?i), JS RegExp has no such syntax and will throw.

unattended.$comment: What may run with no human confirming each individual step - replay with attended:false, and discovery, which has no per-step confirmation mechanism at all. requiresApproval only gates replay (discovery has no capability yet to be approved); maxTier/onIrreversible gate both.

redaction.$comment: Applied at the perception boundary, before an observation reaches the model, the trace, an artifact or a log. Redacting at write time is too late — by then the value has already been sent to the planner.
